---
title: "Abbott and McKibbin Need to Talk"
date: "2009-12-04"
categories: ["Economics", "Politics"]
---

[Michael Stutchbury](http://blogs.theaustralian.news.com.au/currentaccount/index.php/theaustralian/comments/mckibbin_buid_to_spread_the_load#64364 "Michael Stutchbury") makes the case for Liberal leader Tony Abbott to adopt Warwick McKibbin’s hybrid ETS-cabon tax as a counter to Labor’s ETS.  Former opposition leader Malcolm Turnbull was [once sold](../2009/tony_abbott_offers_support_for_a_carbon_tax.qmd "once sold") on the McKibbin model when in government, but couldn’t be bothered making the case from opposition.
